representativeTask.title: Run a representative coding-agent task with pinned Continue through Zeck
representativeTask.description: Run the pinned Continue runtime (upstream 5522c6f44ca0ac3528b37244818fbfa39b5af470, continuedev/continue — the IDE/model platform monorepo at its main head) on a representative corpus task (agent-edit-task: a real code edit through the Continue CLI agent loop's Bash/Edit tool path). Continue operates with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every model-role call — the CLI agent loop's chat turns, the Subagent tool's child sessions, the edit and fast-apply paths, the tab-autocomplete engine, the codebase indexer's embedding call and the retrieval reranker — becomes a real Zeck execution through the public API; the task result (the implemented function, verified by the corpus check script) and the full Zeck execution trace (lifecycle, route, verification, usage) are exposed.

reproducibility.instructions: From the Zeck repository root: (1) clone and build the pinned Continue verbatim with its own toolchain: git clone https://github.com/continuedev/continue.git /home/z/my-project/continue && cd /home/z/my-project/continue && git checkout 5522c6f44ca0ac3528b37244818fbfa39b5af470 && (cd packages/config-types && bun install && bun run build) && (cd packages/fetch && bun install && bun run build) && (cd packages/llm-info && bun install && bun run build) && (cd packages/terminal-security && bun install && bun run build) && (cd packages/config-yaml && bun install && bun run build) && (cd packages/openai-adapters && bun install && bun run build) && (cd core && bun add -d @types/minimatch@latest && bun install && bun run build) && (cd extensions/cli && bun install); (2) run the battery: bun run compat/continue/harness/run-battery.ts — it composes the Zeck public API in-process, serves the OpenAI-compatible Zeck adapter (all four Continue wire surfaces) on a loopback port, runs the pinned Continue runtime over the 7-task role corpus under the credential-scrubbed allowlist environment, the default-deny egress proxy + fetch-level preload, and the role-model config.yaml, and writes deploy/evidence/ppr-021.json with every execution's Zeck trace. The model supply is the sandbox's authorized GLM endpoint (platform-side BYOK material at /etc/.z-ai-config). The website's certified demo run executes the same pinned composition through the PPR-018A harness (the Continue pinned-runtime driver registered at the deployment seam — compat/continue/runtime/continue-pinned-driver.ts).

The declared corpus drives Continue's own headless surfaces (the Continue CLI agent loop + the core role APIs); the IDE GUI orchestration layer is disclosed as not headless-runnable (see the record's limitations).
